Early Prisoner Releases Raise Concerns Over Tagging Failures

Hundreds of prisoners released early across England and Wales are not being electronically tagged, according to MPs. Clive Efford stated that Serco has failed to source enough tags, leading to difficulties for police and probation services managing the influx of newly released offenders, including those convicted of stalking and violent crimes. The second stage of the early release scheme is set to begin, with hundreds more prisoners expected to be freed.
